method: Point-in-time route snapshot built from current GSC and GA4 voice/search signals, current SERP checks for Verity voice questions, the official Smiley's Better Voice CurseForge project page, the exact CurseForge file record, the Verity JE parent project page, the VERITY.exe voice notes page, and a public Reddit player question about chat working while voice is silent. This file never hosts JARs, records API keys, uploads audio, or treats a voice add-on as an official Verity JE replacement.

observedDemand.ga4Window: Last 7 days checked July 30, 2026 at 23:55 Asia/Shanghai
searchAndPlayerSignals: A recent Reddit player report asks why Verity messages appear in chat but no voice can be heard.
Current search results surface Smiley's Better Voice as a Verity JE add-on for voice, TTS, and voice mimicking.
The existing voice troubleshooting route already receives user attention in GA4, so a dedicated add-on route can satisfy deeper voice and TTS intent without changing homepage TDK.

addons.name: Smiley's Better Voice
addons.minecraftVersion: 1.20.1 primary Forge route; older 1.21.1 NeoForge row also visible
addons.sourceNote: Official CurseForge project route for Smiley's Better Voice by Toast5. The page describes it as an add-on to VarmiteYT's Verity JE for more expressive TTS voices and voice mimicking, not as a replacement for Verity JE, not as a Bedrock MCADDON, not as VERITY.exe, and not as a file mirror.
requirements: Minecraft 1.20.1 for the current 4.0.0 Forge file
Verity JE 5.0+ according to the project requirement table
Both Verity JE and Smiley's Better Voice installed together
providers: Fish Audio as the default quality/emotion route
Cartesia AI as the faster pronunciation route
Separate API key, voice ID, speed, and volume settings for each TTS provider
privacyNotes: Voice mimicking uses Fish Audio and can upload about 10 seconds of clean captured speech to create a private voice model.
Mimics are described as private to the player's Fish account and stored server-side for multiplayer.
This checker does not collect provider keys, voice IDs, audio samples, or Minecraft logs.
troubleshooting: Invalid API Key while talking to Verity may be a Groq or Ollama key problem in Verity JE rather than a Fish or Cartesia key problem.
Silent Verity should be checked by enabling Better Voice, enabling Verity JE text-to-speech, confirming provider key plus voice ID, and testing online.
Voice mimic failure usually needs a valid Fish key, enough credits, and roughly 10 seconds of clean push-to-talk speech.
Throw scream repeating after landing was documented as fixed in 3.0.0, so old behavior should be checked against the current file.

routePolicy: Use this route when the player specifically asks about Smiley's Better Voice, Fish Audio, Cartesia, voice mimicking, better Verity TTS, or a Verity JE voice add-on. Do not use it as the default Verity JE download route, a Bedrock route, or a generic voice-not-working answer until the installed project and provider layer are identified.
